name: Dosbarrios (Spain)
description: Sky blue field charged at the centre with the crowned arms of Dosbarrios (a castle, a fountain and a crescent on blue behind a cross of Saint James).
history: The heraldic arms and the flag were officially approved on 16 April 2001 and published in the Diario Oficial de Castilla-La Mancha of 27 April 2001; the arms are azure, a castle or masoned sable, a fountain or and a crescent argent in pale, surmounted by a cross of Saint James gules fimbriated argent, with a closed royal crown. The flag is rectangular, of proportions 2:3, a sky blue cloth with the municipal arms at the centre.
